title: My favourite café
instructions: Paul en sevdiği kafeyi anlatıyor. Neden sevdiğine ve ne zaman gittiğine dikkat et.

script.speaker: paul
script.text: My favourite café is a small place called Bean There, near my office.

script.speaker: paul
script.text: I go there almost every morning before work.

script.speaker: paul
script.text: The coffee is excellent, and it's cheaper than the big chain cafés.

script.speaker: paul
script.text: The owner, Maria, knows my name and always remembers my order.

script.speaker: paul
script.text: The only problem is that it's very small. At lunchtime, you can never find a seat.

questions.prompt: What does Paul say about the price?
options: It's more expensive than chain cafés.
It's cheaper than the big chain cafés.
It's the same as other cafés.
questions.evidence: it's cheaper than the big chain cafés.

questions.prompt: What is the problem with the café?
questions.feedback: Çok küçük; öğle saatinde yer bulunmuyor.
